cast: SPINE thesis. Refrain: "Come look.". Features: ruth, church-classroom, the-doorkeeper, the-untouched-stack, sub-agent. Ruth has read to the children at a small church for twenty years and knows exactly what makes a lesson land, and nobody has ever asked her to write any of it down. When the church asks for a book, she learns that writing it down is the easy half: a written rule can be read, agreed with, and forgotten. Every rule that mattered had to stop being a sentence and become something that refuses. What she ends up with is not a faster helper. It is a thing that can finish the work and say two words at the end.
